headlines.title: Dividend Reliability Might Change The Case For Investing In Procter & Gamble Stock (PG)
headlines.summary: Procter & Gamble continues to draw attention for its long record of dividend reliability, with recent commentary highlighting a 70 year streak of dividend increases and a dividend that has historically been covered by free cash flow. Compared with peers facing acquisition related pressures and weaker dividend coverage, Procter & Gamble's role as a defensive household products supplier reinforces its appeal to investors focused on steady cash returns.

headlines.title: Pittston Co-Packers Appoints Joseph Nickell Chief Executive Officer to Lead Next Phase of Operational Excellence and Strategic Growth
headlines.summary: Pittston Co-Packers, a U.S.-based beverage manufacturing and co-packing company, today announced the appointment of Joseph "Joey" Nickell as Chief Executive Officer, effective November 5, 2026.

headlines.title: Why Investors Should Own Businesses That Can Win Under Any Administration
headlines.summary: The United States holds elections every two years, which is too short a period to justify a long-term investment.

headlines.title: How Many Shares of Kimberly-Clark, Clorox or Procter & Gamble Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, a hypothetical retiree needs 2,400 Clorox shares (about $262,700), 2,344 Kimberly-Clark shares (about $256,500) or 2,759 Procter & Gamble shares (about $468,500) to collect $1,000 a month in dividends. Procter & Gamble’s check costs the most by far, but its dividend took just 67% of free cash flow over the 12 months to Sept.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola and J&J Just Hit Record Highs. A 62-Year-Old Put $300,000 Into Them and Procter & Gamble in 2016. Here’s How Much the Now 72-Year-Old Gets Paid Every Single Month
headlines.summary: A 62-year-old split $300,000 across Johnson & Johnson, Procter & Gamble and Coca-Cola on Nov. 14, 2016. Ten years of dividend raises later, here is the monthly check at 72, the cash collected, what the shares are worth after Friday's record highs, the reinvested version, and the federal tax on the checks.

description: The Procter & Gamble Company provides branded consumer packaged goods worldwide. It operates through five segments: Beauty; Grooming; Health Care; Fabric & Home Care; and Baby, Feminine & Family Care. The company offers conditioners, shampoos, styling aids, and treatments under the Head & Shoulders, Herbal Essences, Pantene, and Rejoice brands; antiperspirants, deodorants, and personal cleansing products under the Native, Old Spice, Safeguard, and Secret brands; and facial moisturizers, cleaners, and treatments under the Olay and SK-II brands. It also provides blades, razors, shave products, appliances, and other grooming products under the Braun, Gillette, and Venus brands. In addition, the company offers toothbrushes, toothpastes, and other oral care products under the Crest and Oral-B brands; and gastrointestinal, pain relief, rapid diagnostics, respiratory, vitamins/minerals/supplements, and other personal health care products under the Metamucil, Neurobion, Pepto-Bismol, and Vicks brands. Further, it provides fabric enhancers, and laundry additives and detergents under the Ariel, Downy, Gain, and Tide brands; and air and dish care, P&G professional, and surface care under the Cascade, Dawn, Fairy, Febreze, Mr. Clean, and Swiffer brands. Additionally, the company offers baby wipes, taped diapers, and pants under the Luvs and Pampers brands; adult incontinence and menstrual care products under the Always, Always Discreet, and Tampax brands; and paper towels, tissues, and toilet papers under the Bounty, Charmin, and Puffs brands. It sells its products through mass merchandisers, social ecommerce channels, grocery and specialty beauty stores, membership club stores, drug and department stores, distributors, wholesalers, airport duty-free and high-frequency stores, pharmacies, electronics stores, and professional channels, as well as directly to consumers. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio.
